payload.summary: Verified camera profile handling; corrected comparison evidence; sRGB remains default for sRGB delivery.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Inspect representative iPhone 17 and Sony A7CR files and record container/RAW type and profile.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Local samples verified: five iPhone 17 Pro DNGs (com.adobe.raw-image), one 8-bit iPhone 17 Pro HEIC (public.heic), and two Sony ILCE-7CR ARWs (com.sony.arw-raw-image). All report Display P3; the RAW CIImage develop space is P3, not an embedded ICC profile, while the HEIC has a Display P3 profile.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trace source decoding/conversion into the current working space and canvas/export tagging.
acceptance_criteria.notes: ImageIO/Core Image decode the embedded profile for HEIC and CIRAWFilter produces P3-tagged RAW images. CIContext color matches input to its working space and renders to the requested destination space. WorkingSpace.current is sRGB; preview presentation and canvas layer are tagged sRGB, and default exports use the same render graph and output profile.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Determine whether sRGB loses source colors using reproducible pixel/profile evidence.
acceptance_criteria.notes: At an 800 px long edge, direct P3 RGBA8 renders were compared with sRGB RGBA8 renders reopened with the sRGB tag and rendered back to P3. Across these samples 0-3.32% of pixels differ by >2/255, 0-1.22% by >8/255, max channel delta 37/255. Linear-sRGB gamut checks found 0% out-of-gamut pixels in both Sony ARWs, 0-4.39% in the iPhone DNGs, and 1.81% in the HEIC. This confirms limited but real gamut loss on sRGB output; it is not hardware colorimeter evidence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Record a concrete recommendation and address preview/export, thumbnails, Looks/LUTs, caches/signatures, and profiles.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Keep the color-managed sRGB canvas for the Instagram-first MVP because it matches default sRGB delivery; a P3 canvas alone would diverge from the default export. A future P3-preserving mode requires a coherent migration of WorkingSpace.current, derived-LUT fitting, LUT interpolation, frame signatures/caches, thumbnails, output tagging, and preview/export parity.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Create/propose a scoped follow-up only if the evidence supports implementation.
acceptance_criteria.notes: No implementation follow-up created: the measured loss is expected at the current sRGB delivery boundary and does not establish a product requirement for P3 output. The future migration boundary is documented.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add deterministic coverage for any confirmed regression and separate software evidence from hardware validation.
acceptance_criteria.notes: No conversion regression was found; the observed difference is the expected sRGB gamut boundary. No production code changed, and the hardware/colorimeter comparison remains unperformed.

payload.summary: Verification passed; fixed sheet and delay gating, then built and ran focused tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A clean Export or Export All of at least one non-identity edit counts after the batch job has finished and the success status is posted.
acceptance_criteria.notes: editedExportCount increments after each committed edited file; the settled callback runs after finishJob and the summary status. ExportCoordinatorTests verifies edited batch counts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The first qualifying finish and later finishes in the same launch remain silent.
acceptance_criteria.notes: ReviewPromptPolicy records the first finish launch and requires a later launch; policy tests cover first and same-launch behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A later-launch qualifying finish may request once after about one second, only with an active app, key window, and no job, sheet, alert, or welcome flow.
acceptance_criteria.notes: AppViewModel checks quiet-app gates before scheduling and again before presentation. On macOS StoreKit uses AppStore.requestReview(in:) with the key window content view controller.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The request date is recorded only when the presenter invokes the API, with a 120-day minimum interval.
acceptance_criteria.notes: The policy records only after the presenter returns that it made the request; injected-clock tests cover the interval boundary.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Share, Copy, original-plus-settings, external-editor, identity-only, cancelled, partial, and Photos-failed operations remain silent.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Only the batch-settled callback feeds qualification; the policy requires successful edited exports and rejects failures, cancellation, and Photos delivery failures. External-editor completion remains separate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A qualifying finish covered by a sheet, alert, inactive app, or running export is counted but does not produce a later surprise request.
acceptance_criteria.notes: The finish is counted before quiet-state checks. A covered finish is not scheduled, and the quiet gate is rechecked when a scheduled delay expires.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shutdown and new exports, shares, copies, sheets, and alerts cancel a pending wait.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Shutdown, export activity, error presentation, and AppKit sheet-begin notifications cancel the task; Photos picker and deletion confirmation changes are also wired. Fake-presenter tests cover sheet, export, alert, and shutdown cancellation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: There is no custom rating UI, Settings toggle, or new sandbox entitlement.
acceptance_criteria.notes: The implementation only calls StoreKit and stores engagement state in UserDefaults; no entitlement or settings UI changes were made.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Injected policy tests and a fake-presenter wiring test cover the review flow without presenting the system sheet.
acceptance_criteria.notes: ReviewPromptTests uses private defaults, an injected clock, and FakeReviewPresenter; the production presenter is not called in tests.
